# pi-tools repository context

Use the lane that supplies missing evidence. Lanes are independent and may be used alone or in a useful order; none authorizes mutation or creates an effort.

<!-- awf:edit orient: default; create .awf/skills/parts/repository-context/orient.md to override -->
## Orient

Use before substantial fresh work, resume, takeover, or widened scope. Read the applicable repository guidance, current state, relevant decisions, source, tests, and recent history; on resume, revalidate the whole checkpoint rather than trusting memory. State the applicable constraints and remaining uncertainty. Exact-known-file reads need no skill.

<!-- awf:edit explore: default; create .awf/skills/parts/repository-context/explore.md to override -->
## Explore

Delegate one bounded unknown to the `explorer` agent only when a separate read-only investigation is useful. Give it a question and searched boundary. Return its answer first, then evidence, uncertainty, and the boundary searched. Do not turn exploration into a workflow stage or delegate a conclusion that can be established by an exact known read.

<!-- awf:edit challenge: default; create .awf/skills/parts/repository-context/challenge.md to override -->
## Challenge

For broad, weak, unfamiliar, or high-consequence premises, ask the `premise-checker` to try to falsify the premise. Report **supported**, **revise**, or **unresolved**, with consequence-ordered evidence. Revise the route or surface an unresolved material decision; a challenge is evidence, not approval.
